nlw_archivist.text: Croeso. This is the National Library of Wales. Since 1911 it has been entitled to a free copy of every book published in Britain.
We keep the Black Book of Carmarthen, from around 1250. It is thought to be the oldest surviving manuscript written entirely in Welsh.
We also hold the Hengwrt Chaucer, one of the very earliest copies of the Canterbury Tales. Do not breathe on it, but do admire it.

nlw_reader.text: I am tracing my family tree. So far it leads to a farm, a chapel and a long argument about a gate.
